decisions.executionNote: Remain at origin with both grippers open while observing the demonstration order.
Wait without arm motion; demonstrator is grasping the wooden car first.
Observe only; first demonstrated object is the wooden car, now lifted.
Stay still. Remember car as first; observe its release and the next selection.
Car is released in demonstration basket. Continue observing, no policy motion.
Wait at origin. Demonstrator approaches the black doll for the second selection, following car.
Observe only. Sequence so far: wooden car, black doll now grasped.
Wait and remember car then doll; demonstrator is transporting doll to its basket.
Remain still. Car then doll are in the demo basket; watch the third selection.
Wait at origin and observe third selection; remembered order is car, doll.
Remain still; demonstrator selects the green watch third, after car and doll.
Observe watch being carried third; retain order car, doll, watch. No policy motion.
Wait for watch release and fourth selection. Remember car, doll, watch.
Remain still as demonstration continues; car, doll, watch have been placed in that order.
Observe only. Demonstrator selects phone fourth after car, doll, watch.
Wait at origin. Phone is carried fourth; remembered sequence is car, doll, watch, phone.
Observe phone release fourth; continue waiting for final object and demonstrator return.
Stay still; four demonstrated placements observed: car, doll, watch, phone. Await final camera placement.
Wait while demonstrator grasps camera fifth. Memorized order: car, doll, watch, phone, camera.
Stay at origin while camera is transported fifth; await full demonstration completion.
Wait for final camera release and demonstrator return. Order: car, doll, watch, phone, camera.
All five demonstration objects appear in basket; wait for opposite arm to finish returning before moving.
Demonstrator has returned. Begin first object, wooden car: raise and orient right gripper downward gradually, keeping left arm parked.
Advance right hand above wooden car, finish downward orientation, then begin a shallow descent; verify alignment before closing.
Refine car alignment and rotate jaw span across its narrow dimension while descending slowly; depth remains uncertain.
Lower around the wooden car, make a small centering adjustment, then close fully. Verify retention on the following lift.
Lift the first car and bring it toward a central staging location for a left-arm pickup, keeping the right arm on its own side.
Car remains visible in the grasp. Move to the right edge of the centerline and lower it onto the table for a non-crossing staged transfer.
Release car on the central table and withdraw right hand upward then rightward. Raise and orient left hand for pickup without crossing arms.
Car is resting on the central table. Move left hand above its left edge while withdrawing right hand well into the right workspace.
Lower the open left gripper toward the staged car with a small centering correction; keep its EE left of center and right arm stationary.
Complete a shallow descent and slight fingertip centering tilt, then close left gripper on the staged car; assess on lift.
Lift the car in the left grasp and move leftward above the table toward the policy basket, maintaining clearance.
Car is retained. Carry it over the front half of the policy basket and begin lowering for the first placement.
Lower and release the car inside the policy basket, then lift clear with the left gripper open before selecting the second object.
Car is visibly inside the basket. Approach the black doll second, rotating the open left jaws across its body while staying left of center.
Replan from the interrupted pose with much smaller increments; center the open left gripper over the doll and descend cautiously.
Lower gently around the second object, close fully on the doll, and make a short verification lift.
Doll appears retained on the short lift. Raise it further while carrying left toward a free area of the basket for the second placement.
Move the held doll over the basket behind the car and lower carefully for the second release.
Release doll second and lift left hand clear. Bring open right gripper above the green watch, the third target.
Adjust right-hand alignment forward over the watch while lowering slowly; keep jaws open and verify the near view before grasping.
Center the watch between the right jaws, descend a little, close fully, and perform a short retention-check lift.
Watch was not retained. Reopen and recenter slightly left and back over the visible watch before another grasp.
Fine-center the watch farther back between the jaws, close, and lift slightly to check retention.
The watch appears displaced rather than held. Reopen and lift clear, changing jaw angle for a fresh visual alignment.
Account for the link6-to-fingertip offset: move toward the watch in the wrist view while lowering with jaws open.
Watch is now centered in the wrist view. Lower slightly, close fully around it, then lift a short distance to verify retention.
Retry the watch at a slightly lower grasp depth, accounting for its small displacement; close and test with a short lift.
Correct the grasp leftward and slightly back using the head view; grasp the watch band at table height and test retention.
Watch appears held by its band. Lift clear and carry toward the central staging area, keeping the right EE on the right side.
Watch slipped during transport and remains on the table. Return open right hand to its new location for a more secure face-side grasp.
Align the open jaws with the watch case rather than the loose band, using the wrist image and a gentle descent.
Close around the centered watch case, then lift slowly to verify that the entire watch follows the gripper.
Test the watch grasp with a slow lift and short leftward motion; keep closed and verify retention visually before transport.
Watch is not retained. Reopen and align the case with the actual fingertip convergence point rather than the lower wrist-image center.
Watch case now aligns with the fingertip convergence point. Lower slightly, close, and test a slow vertical lift.
Watch case is visibly retained. Lift and transport slowly toward the central transfer area, keeping the gripper closed.
Move the retained watch to the centerline staging area and lower it; reorient the distant left gripper for the subsequent pickup.
Set the watch on the central table and withdraw the right arm. Approach with the left arm, keeping the workspaces separated.
Approach the staged watch with the left gripper, stopping left of the centerline; retract right hand to its own rear workspace.
Reorient the left gripper above the table so its fingertips can reach the staged watch while link6 remains in the left workspace.
Center the staged watch under the reoriented left fingertips and descend with open jaws, keeping link6 left of center.
Align the watch case with the left fingertip convergence point, close at table height, and make a small verification lift.
Watch case remains outside the closed jaws. Reopen and tilt the left fingertips toward it while keeping link6 left of center; refine before closing again.
Fine-center the watch case between the left fingertips, close and test a slow lift while keeping the arm left of center.
Watch case appears retained. Lift and carry slowly left toward the basket while maintaining the closed grasp.
Watch remains retained. Carry it over the policy basket between the first two objects and lower for the third placement.
Release watch third and withdraw left hand. Approach the phone fourth with the right hand, aligning jaws across its narrow width.
Lower the open right gripper toward the phone and compensate the wrist-view offset, aiming to grip its sides.
Shift back to grip the phone near its middle rather than its end, close fully, and test a short lift.
Lift the retained phone and bring it to central staging; prepare the left gripper at a safe lateral distance for pickup.
Lower and release the phone at the centerline staging area, then lift the right gripper clear for a left-arm pickup.
Withdraw right hand into the right workspace and bring the open left hand above the staged phone without crossing the arms.
Lower left gripper around the phone and tilt its fingertips slightly toward the centerline while keeping link6 left of center.
Refine the phone centering, close the left jaws on its sides, and lift briefly to check retention.
Phone is retained by the left gripper. Raise and carry it toward the policy basket for the fourth placement.
Carry the retained phone over the left portion of the policy basket and lower with clearance above the earlier objects.
Phone is visibly in the basket fourth. Open and lift clear, then approach the remaining black camera for the fifth placement.
Lower the open left gripper toward the last camera, refining horizontal alignment from the head and wrist views before closing.
Center the camera between the left fingertips, descend gently to its sides, and close; retention will be checked on lift.
